items.content: Under the 2026 Withholding Tax Rules in this corpus, what tax must a specified person deduct when paying rent for office premises, and what rate or table supports it?

The reviewed 2026 evidence identifies who may be a “specified person,” but it does not establish the rule requiring deduction on office-premises rent or the applicable rent-withholding rate or table. The Act lists specified-person categories, including certain businesses above stated turnover thresholds; an NBR order also designates specified public bodies, education institutions and private institutes for withholding duties. [1][2]

The reviewed evidence does not establish the operative duty to deduct tax on office-premises rent or the applicable 2026 withholding rate or table.
